resources.string: Frame rate, HEVC, vehicle controls, logs and diagnostic reports.
Changes apply immediately; CarPlay reconnects automatically when needed.

Address ranges: 169.254.0.0/16 / 100.64.0.0/10. Ports: 1024–65535, for example 169.254.111.111:8080. The connected browser updates its address automatically. If disconnected, enter the updated Android address on the page. Leave blank to use 169.254.111.111 (the saved port stays).
Open TiPlay when Android starts. Android or device settings may restrict background startup.
